= Module: ChatBot Extension =

[https://gitlab.cloudsoziologe.de/edwin/hdp/-/blob/main/app/extensions/ChatBot <code>app/extensions/ChatBot/</code>] is the
MediaWiki extension that provides the chat widget, its REST API surface,
and (unused in this deployment — see below) a built-in wiki-content
indexing pipeline. It was originally built against '''Deepset Cloud'''’s
hosted RAG API; in this deployment it talks to the self-hosted Haystack
pipeline through [[Help:Modul/Docker-Services#chatbot-proxy|<code>chatbot-proxy</code>]]
instead, with no PHP code changes — only configuration
([https://gitlab.cloudsoziologe.de/edwin/hdp/-/blob/main/app/settings.d/100-ChatBot.php <code>100-ChatBot.php</code>]).

== Responsibilities ==

* '''Chat UI''' — a TypeScript/webpack-bundled widget (<code>resources/ts/</code>, built to <code>resources/js/dist/bmbf.chat.bundle.js</code>) with SSE streaming, six answer modes, session persistence, feedback, and export.
* '''REST API''' — MediaWiki REST endpoints under <code>/bmbf/*</code> for chat, session creation, history, and feedback.
* '''Deepset API connector''' — a Guzzle-based HTTP client (<code>src/DeepsetApi/</code>) that talks to whatever URLs <code>$wgBmbfDeepsetApi*</code> point at — in this deployment, <code>chatbot-proxy</code>.
* '''Built-in content indexing''' (present in code, '''inert''' here) — hooks into BlueSpiceExtendedSearch to queue wiki content, and a background job pushes it to a Deepset-shaped index API. See [[#notable-patterns--gotchas|Notable Patterns / Gotchas]].
* '''Feedback &amp; admin''' — collects per-answer user feedback, exposes an admin stats dashboard (<code>src/AdminModule/Stats.php</code>).
* '''PDF/ODF export''' — exports chat transcripts via the <code>PDFCreator</code> extension.

* [https://gitlab.cloudsoziologe.de/edwin/hdp/-/blob/main/app/extensions/ChatBot/extension.json <code>extension.json</code>] — manifest: REST routes, hooks, config schema, the <code>Ministerium</code>/<code>Projektträger</code> namespaces (5000/5002), resource modules

* [https://gitlab.cloudsoziologe.de/edwin/hdp/-/blob/main/app/extensions/ChatBot/src/Rest/History.php <code>src/Rest/History.php</code>], [https://gitlab.cloudsoziologe.de/edwin/hdp/-/blob/main/app/extensions/ChatBot/src/Rest/ChatFeedback.php <code>src/Rest/ChatFeedback.php</code>] — history and feedback handlers

=== Configuration (<code>$wg</code>-prefixed MediaWiki globals) ===

MediaWiki’s default <code>GlobalVarConfig</code> reads <code>$wg</code>-prefixed globals because
<code>extension.json</code> declares no <code>config_prefix</code> override — see the gotcha in
[[Help:Modul/Settings.d#notable-patterns--gotchas|settings-d]]. Set in
[https://gitlab.cloudsoziologe.de/edwin/hdp/-/blob/main/app/settings.d/100-ChatBot.php <code>100-ChatBot.php</code>]:

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Global
! Value in this deployment
! Read by
|-
| <code>$wgBmbfDeepsetApiChatUrl</code>
| <code>http://chatbot-proxy:8080</code>
| <code>ChatApi</code>, <code>SessionApi</code>
|-
| <code>$wgBmbfDeepsetApiSearchSessionsUrl</code>
| <code>http://chatbot-proxy:8080/session</code>
| <code>SessionApi</code>
|-
| <code>$wgBmbfDeepsetApiKey</code>
| <code>not-needed</code> (proxy ignores auth)
| <code>Connector::executeRequest()</code> (sent as <code>Bearer</code> header)
|-
| <code>$wgBmbfDeepsetApiIndexUrl</code>
| <code>''</code> (empty — see gotchas below)
| <code>IndexApi</code>
|-
| <code>$wgBmbfDeepsetApiFeedbackUrl</code>, <code>$wgBmbfDeepsetApiTagUrl</code>, <code>$wgBmbfDeepsetPipelineStatsUrl</code>
| <code>''</code>
| <code>FeedbackApi</code>, admin stats
|}

== Internal Structure ==

<pre>ChatBot/
├── extension.json              # routes, hooks, config schema, namespaces
├── includes/ServiceWiring.php  # DI for Deepset*Api services
├── src/
│   ├── DeepsetApi/              # HTTP clients (Connector base + 6 subclasses)
│   ├── Rest/                    # MediaWiki REST handlers (thin, delegate to DeepsetApi/*)
│   ├── ExternalIndex/           # BlueSpiceExtendedSearch hook (queues bmbf_index_pages)
│   ├── RunJobsTriggerHandler/   # IndexDeepset background job (every 5 min)
│   ├── Hook/, HookHandler/      # permissions, tags, UI slot registration
│   ├── Model/                   # ChatMessage model + factory
│   ├── PdfExport/                # PDF/ODF export integration
│   └── Util/RoleLookup.php      # namespace/role-based filtering for RAG queries
├── resources/
│   ├── ts/                      # TypeScript source for the chat widget
│   └── js/dist/                 # webpack bundle actually shipped to the browser
├── i18n/                        # de, en, qqq message files
└── db/bmbf_index_pages.sql      # index queue table schema</pre>
== Dependencies ==

* '''Uses:''' <code>BlueSpiceFoundation</code> (config registry, services), <code>BlueSpiceExtendedSearch</code> (<code>ExternalIndexRegistry</code> attribute for <code>UpdateIndexTable</code>), <code>PDFCreator</code> (chat export), MWStake <code>RunJobsTrigger</code> component (<code>IndexDeepset</code> scheduling), <code>ContentDroplets</code> (the <code>chatbotmeta</code> page-metadata droplet), GuzzleHttp (HTTP client).
* '''Used by:''' nothing else in the wiki — top-level extension consumed directly by the browser chat widget.
* '''Requires (at request time):''' <code>chatbot-proxy</code> reachable at <code>$wgBmbfDeepsetApiChatUrl</code> — if unreachable, <code>ChatApi::request()</code> throws and <code>Chat::execute()</code> returns <code>{&quot;errors&quot;: [...]}</code>.

== Notable Patterns / Gotchas ==

* '''SSE passthrough, not re-encoding.''' <code>ChatApi::request()</code> disables PHP output buffering (<code>sendSSEHeaders()</code>), opens a streaming Guzzle request to <code>{apiUrl}/chat-stream</code>, and echoes each line of the upstream SSE response straight to the browser via <code>ob_flush(); flush();</code> — it does not parse or re-shape the event stream. This means <code>chatbot-proxy</code>’s SSE event format (<code>{&quot;type&quot;: &quot;delta&quot;, ...}</code> / <code>{&quot;type&quot;: &quot;result&quot;, ...}</code>) is what the frontend actually consumes; see [[Help:Modul/Haystack-Pipeline|haystack-pipeline]] and [[Help:Diagramme/Sequenzen|diagrams/sequences.md]].
* '''<code>ob_flush()</code> without a buffer can warn.''' Under PHP-FPM there isn’t always an active output buffer when <code>ob_flush()</code> runs (<code>ChatApi.php</code> line 80), producing harmless log noise — a known, documented, non-blocking issue (see <code>docs/QA-REPORT.md</code>).
* '''“Deepset” naming is historical.''' The extension still calls its config keys and classes <code>BmbfDeepsetApi*</code> / <code>DeepsetApi\*</code>, but nothing here talks to Deepset Cloud in this deployment — every URL points at <code>chatbot-proxy</code>, which itself is a hand-rolled Python service, not Haystack’s own hayhooks REST surface directly (see [[Help:Modul/Haystack-Pipeline|haystack-pipeline]] for why).
* '''The extension’s built-in indexing pipeline is inert here.''' <code>UpdateIndexTable</code> (an <code>ExternalIndexRegistry</code> hook) still queues page changes into the <code>bmbf_index_pages</code> table on every edit, and <code>IndexDeepset::run()</code> still fires every 5 minutes via MWStake’s <code>RunJobsTrigger</code>/<code>EveryFiveMinutes</code> interval, draining that queue and calling <code>IndexApi::pushPage()</code>/<code>batchDelete()</code> against <code>$wgBmbfDeepsetApiIndexUrl</code>. Since that URL is configured empty in [https://gitlab.cloudsoziologe.de/edwin/hdp/-/blob/main/app/settings.d/100-ChatBot.php <code>100-ChatBot.php</code>], those calls have nowhere to go. '''The actual index population path in this deployment is the separate [[Help:Modul/Ingestion|<code>ingest_hdp_wiki.py</code>]] script''', run manually against OpenSearch directly — see [[Help:Architektur#key-design-decisions|architecture.md]].
* '''Role-based RAG filtering is built but not wired through.''' <code>ChatApi::getFilter()</code> builds an OpenSearch metadata filter excluding the <code>Ministerium</code> (<code>NS_BMBF</code>, 5000) and/or <code>Projektträger</code> (<code>NS_PT</code>, 5002) namespaces from retrieval results for users who aren’t in the corresponding BlueSpice role (<code>RoleLookup::isBMBF()</code> / <code>isProjectSponsor()</code>), unless the user is a sysop or maintainer, and sends it as a <code>filters</code> field in the request body to <code>chatbot-proxy</code>. But <code>chatbot-proxy</code>’s <code>_handle_chat_stream()</code>/<code>call_hayhooks()</code> (see [[Help:Modul/Haystack-Pipeline|haystack-pipeline]]) only reads <code>body[&quot;query&quot;]</code> from that request — it does not read or forward <code>filters</code>, so this access-control filter is currently '''not enforced end-to-end''' in this deployment.
* '''<code>followUpType</code> (the six answer modes) is likewise not forwarded.''' <code>ChatApi::request()</code> sends <code>params.ConditionalRouter.path</code> set to the user-selected mode — <code>rag</code>, <code>followup_short</code>, <code>followup_elaborate</code>, <code>followup_bulletpoints</code>, <code>followup_onlytext</code>, or <code>followup_citations</code> (see its docblock) — but <code>chatbot-proxy</code>’s <code>call_hayhooks()</code> hardcodes <code>&quot;path&quot;: &quot;rag&quot;</code> in the body it sends to the pipeline regardless of what the extension sent. In this deployment, every chat request is answered in the default <code>rag</code> style even if the UI’s follow-up mode selector says otherwise.
